text:
ashley-billing: Heads-up — Novum Health (acct NOV-004) submitted an appeal after we suspended service for non-payment. They say they provided a PO (PO-8897) marked EU VAT-exempt but our billing matched country=UK and tax_id was missing, so invoice was not auto-exempted. Card on file also declined 3x. Customer requests immediate reinstatement while they confirm a wire transfer.

matt-cs: on it. can you attach the PO copy and invoice id? customer says production jobs failing — want a very short window if possible.

ashley-billing: attached the PO in the support ticket (link in the ticket). invoice id is 44521, dunning progressed to suspension yesterday. PO text shows "Novum Health | PO-8897 | VAT EXEMPT" but no VAT reg number. customer claims exemption via gov registry.

jenna-payments: reviewing gateway logs — card declines show 3DS/issuer challenge required. gateway returned failure_code: "card_requires_auth", decline_reason: "authentication_required" on attempts at 1829119000, 1829120200, 1829121200. snippet:```json
{"attempts":3,"last_response":{"code":"A3","message":"3DS required","gateway_tx":"gt_8f3b"}}
```

sam-ops: quick note — when account is suspended we block API keys which causes client errors that look like latency/timeouts at their app layer. unsuspending should immediately restore traffic if keys are intact. if we re-enable, we should set a manual collection hold so automated retries don't re-trigger suspension.

billing-bot: Invoice 44521 triggered dunning email to billing@novumhealth.com at 1829020000 and suspension action executed at 1829070000.

sara-cs: I'm on the call with Novum now. they say finance initiated a same-day wire this morning and will provide SWIFT reference within 2 hours. they absolutely need a 2-hour window to finish a production rollout. asking for a short reprieve.

derek-fin: policy check: we can approve a temporary manual re-enable as an exception if they provide a credible payment trace and PO verification. conditions: (1) set manual_collection_hold=true, (2) re-enable for <=24h, (3) require SWIFT/ref uploaded to ticket and confirmation of funds within 24h. I'm OK to approve 24h.

jenna-payments: I'll perform the unlock and set the hold flag. steps I will take: 1) flip account.suspended=false 2) set account.meta.pending_wire=true 3) annotate invoice 44521 with the PO number and note "VAT pending verification". After wire posts we will clear pending_wire and resume normal collections.

ashley-billing: executed step 1 and 2 at 1829123600 — lifted suspension and applied manual hold. Notified customer (they responded :relieved:). Logged follow-up ticket to validate VAT exemption after finance receives their gov registry doc.

jenna-payments: added note to payment processing queue to re-attempt reconciliation when we receive SWIFT ref. If wire not seen by 24h, we automatically re-suspend per policy.

matt-cs: thanks all — customer confirmed they could finish rollout. please paste the SWIFT ref into the ticket when available.

ashley-billing: filing final checklist in the ticket: PO copy present, SWIFT pending, temporary re-enable granted until 1829200000 (24h). will close this thread once reconciliation completes. :thumbsup:
